copyright: Lane-Contract-Registry: canonical mapping of every repurposed ObjectUniforms lane for the liquid style struct. Engine <-> liquid-extras (Noir/Oil). Part of T3 of the liquid roadmap (see .agents/collaborate/liquid-roadmap.md §8.2 T3).

uniformSlot.note: 512 bytes (ADR 0027, supersedes the 256-byte moat of ADR 0026). Base lanes u_styleA/u_styleB stay; semantic/material lanes ride u_matParam0..15. New parameters travel via repurposed lanes or per-style constants.

structMembers.u_matParam0..15: vec4 semantic material lanes, per-preset (e.g. OpenWater poolHalfExtent in u_matParam2.w)

lanes.writeOrder: extension:override (after base pack in same instance)
lanes.collision: overrides base lineWidth meaning; valid ONLY because styleId==3.0 dispatches extension branch

lanes.writeOrder: extension:override (after base pack in same instance)
lanes.collision: overrides base lineWidth meaning; valid ONLY because styleId==3.0 dispatches extension branch

lanes.range: [x, z, spawnTime, energy]; ring active for 0..4 s after spawnTime when energy > 0
world units, > 0 enables wall reflection, 0 = off; default 4.0

registration.purpose: S2 SurfaceRippleField: single registered splat lane vec4 = pos.xz + spawnTime + energy; max 1 active splat per water surface; upload only on impact.
registration.note: Active on OpenWaterMaterial u_styleA [x, z, spawnTime, energy].

registration.purpose: S3 Clapotis wall contract: square basin centred on the world origin, half extent travels in u_matParam2.w (0 = off, default 4.0); wall normal, fade band and amplitude scale are shader constants.
registration.note: Active on OpenWater vertex shaders (GLSL300, GLSL100, WGSL); mirrored by OpenWaterSurfaceProbe (poolHalfExtent lane).

registration.purpose: S1 Wellen-Sonde: OpenWaterSurfaceProbe is the CPU 'same-field' surface-truth probe -- reads the exact u_extraParams/u_liquidParams/u_thresholds/u_reflectivity lanes the OpenWater shader consumes, no re-derived constants; feeds Auftriebswahrheit in the buoyancy solver.
registration.note: Mirror audited op-for-op against OpenWater.vert.glsl + liquid_gerstner_wave.glsl; golden-vector + G2 constants-equality manifest live in packages/engine/tests/core/materials/OpenWaterSurfaceProbe.test.ts.

rules: no two different meanings may occupy the same (lane, materialType) cell unless styleId/mat.type dispatch makes exactly one active
every lane write must be listed here (engine base lanes + extension carve-outs)
eviction of a lane requires re-homing to a per-style constant; silent deletion is forbidden
write order: base pack first, extension override after (single upload path per material instance)
future lanes (S2/S3) must be registered here before implementation
